requested_context.pathway_name: Lipid A biosynthesis (Raetz pathway) in Escherichia coli
main_subprocesses: Acylation of UDP-GlcNAc by LpxA (first step)
MsbA flipping and Lpt transport to OM
requested_context.selected_example: Lipid A biosynthesis in Escherichia coli

candidate_examples.name: Lipid A biosynthesis in Escherichia coli
candidate_examples.evidence: Regulation of LpxC in E. coli (section heading) and extensive coverage of E. coli-specific regulatory mechanisms throughout the review.

candidate_examples.name: Regulation of LpxC by MurA in Pseudomonas aeruginosa
main_subprocesses: Activation of LpxC by MurA binding
candidate_examples.evidence: it was revealed that Pa LpxC is regulated by a wholly unique mechanism: it is activated by direct binding to the committed enzyme in the competing PG biosynthetic pathway, MurA

candidate_examples.name: Ght-mediated regulation of LpxC in Neisseria meningitidis
main_subprocesses: Localization of LpxC to IM by Ght
candidate_examples.evidence: the N. meningitidis LapB homolog Ght was suggested to regulate LpxC through an FtsH-independent mechanism by localizing LpxC to the IM to promote LPS biosynthesis

candidate_examples.name: Lon-mediated degradation of LpxC in alphaproteobacteria
main_subprocesses: Degradation of LpxC by Lon protease
candidate_examples.evidence: turnover of LpxC was shown to be due to the Lon protease, suggesting that Lon might serve as a regulator of LpxC in these bacteria

candidate_examples.name: NtrYX transcriptional regulation of LpxC in Rhodobacter sphaeroides
main_subprocesses: Transcriptional inhibition of lpxC by NtrYX
candidate_examples.evidence: In R. sphaeroides, an ntrYX mutant exhibited approximately nine-fold elevated lpxC transcript abundance and two-fold accumulation of LPS

candidate_examples.name: ChvGI and NtrYX regulation of LpxC in Caulobacter crescentus
candidate_examples.evidence: In C. crescentus, an additional layer of control is imposed by the ChvGI two component system, which activates lpxC transcription

candidate_examples.name: LabP-mediated activation of LpxA in Cronobacter sakazakii
candidate_examples.evidence: LpxA was found to interact with LabP. Consistent with LabP serving as an activator of LpxA, labP mutants had reduced core-lipid A

candidate_examples.name: RipA-mediated inhibition of LpxA in Francisella tularensis
candidate_examples.evidence: RipA was suggested to inhibit LpxA activity due to the ability of hypomorphic LpxA variants to suppress ripA mutant phenotypes
